date_alignment: SnapshotDate is weekly reference date, pair daily observations <= weekly reference only; cannot claim same-date TDCC release.
official_identity_caution_flag_behavior: retain with warning; primary validation must sensitivity exclude flagged 81 rows; if finding relies on these, not eligible
missingness: exclude only incomplete observation window; no zero-fill or daily TDCC ffill
primary_null: No statistically and economically nontrivial cross-episode stock-level multi-group behavioral similarity beyond same-week market-wide conditions.
baseline_0: no predictable/common group behavior, empirical contemporaneous TDCC and institutional measures unrelated conditional on week
baseline_1: within each reference week shuffle TDCC stock identities preserving same-week whole-market distribution, deterministic RNG seed 20261107
baseline_2: for lead-lag shuffle synchronized 4/12-week episode blocks by stock while preserving each block internal values and duration
baseline_3: simple static group medians and null non-overlap time sequences
multiple_testing: Holm Bonferroni across up to 6 primary recipe effects, nominal familywise alpha 0.05; all secondary measures clearly exploratory.
validation_dependent_data: year-block reproducibility and stock bootstrap/block permutation as available; raw stockweeks never treated as iid people
effect_size_min_for_AB: absolute pooled/median within-week Spearman rho >=0.08 for A; absolute asymmetric lead-lag Spearman difference >=0.08 for B
discovery_cross_year_sign: same orientation in >=4 of the 5 discovery calendar years and >=25 eligible stocks per each included week
G4_replication: in both 2023 and 2024 separately, pre-registered primary effect preserves discovery orientation; each annual effect magnitude >=0.05; no retuning; descriptive stability only
